'''Aster Index''' entered the orbit of Host Collective when a member shared it in the collective's community channel in 2024. This connection situates the archive within a wider movement to preserve digital culture.<ref>[https://fixtures.invalid/aster-index/activity-log Public activity log, 2024 excerpt], Aster Index, 31 December 2024.</ref>

The volunteer-maintained archive was established in 2022 and catalogues 480 scanned posters from small bulletin-board communities active from 1998 through 2007. Entries are organized by community, year, and credited designer when known.<ref>[https://fixtures.invalid/aster-index/about About Aster Index], Aster Index, 12 February 2024.</ref>
